criteria_coverage.criterion: AC1: Terms-of-use text is stored in the application with an explicit, comparable version identifier.
criteria_coverage.notes: Confirms both required exports exist as non-empty strings (contract Interface 1). Comparability is exercised transitively by terms-acceptance and route tests that compare against CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION with ===; a direct equality assertion in this module is not present but is not required.

criteria_coverage.criterion: AC2: A teacher without acceptance is prevented from completing first upload and is presented with the current terms plus an explicit affirmative acceptance control (checkbox).
covered_by: src/app/upload/__tests__/page.test.tsx::renders the terms acceptance modal when not accepted
src/components/__tests__/TermsAcceptanceModal.test.tsx::renders terms text, a checkbox, a link to /terms, and a disabled submit until checked
criteria_coverage.notes: Upload page renders the dialog (and omits it when accepted); modal asserts terms text present, a checkbox, and a submit that is disabled until the checkbox is checked — a genuine affirmative control gate with strong assertions on the disabled attribute toggling.

criteria_coverage.criterion: AC3: The server-side upload path rejects uploads from teachers with no acceptance record for the current version (cannot be bypassed via UI).
covered_by: src/app/api/upload/__tests__/route.test.ts::returns 403 with terms_not_accepted when the teacher has no acceptance for the current version
src/app/api/upload/__tests__/route.test.ts::proceeds past the terms gate when the teacher has accepted the current version
criteria_coverage.notes: Directly invokes the route handler with mocked auth/acceptance and asserts 403 + {error:'terms_not_accepted'} on block and non-403 on pass. Enforcement is validated at the server boundary, satisfying the 'unbypassable via UI' requirement.

criteria_coverage.criterion: AC4: Each acceptance records at least teacher identity, accepted version, and a timestamp.
covered_by: src/lib/__tests__/terms-acceptance.test.ts::recordAcceptance writes teacher id, version, and timestamp
criteria_coverage.notes: Unit test asserts persisted params are exactly [TEACHER_ID, CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION] and the returned {acceptedAt} timestamp; route test asserts 201 with {acceptedAt} and that recordAcceptance is called with the resolved teacher id + current version. Identity, version, and timestamp are all pinned.

criteria_coverage.criterion: AC5: A teacher who has already accepted the current version is not re-prompted on subsequent uploads.
covered_by: src/app/upload/__tests__/page.test.tsx::renders the upload form and omits the modal when accepted
src/app/api/upload/__tests__/route.test.ts::proceeds past the terms gate when the teacher has accepted the current version
criteria_coverage.notes: queryByRole('dialog') is asserted null when accepted, encoding the no-re-prompt requirement; route pass-through confirms the gate lets accepted teachers through.

criteria_coverage.criterion: AC6: A teacher can view which terms version they accepted (and when) from account/settings.
covered_by: src/app/settings/__tests__/page.test.tsx::displays the teacher's accepted terms version and acceptance timestamp
src/app/settings/__tests__/page.test.tsx::shows a not-yet-accepted status when the teacher has no current acceptance
criteria_coverage.notes: Accepted case asserts the version substring and a timestamp-derived substring are rendered; not-accepted case asserts a 'not' message. Version assertion is exact; the timestamp assertion (/2026/) is intentionally loose because contract Interface 10 permits either ISO or locale formatting — acceptable but weaker than an exact match (see SR finding on assertion strength).

criteria_coverage.criterion: AC7: The terms content is reachable as a readable page linkable from the acceptance prompt.
covered_by: src/app/terms/__tests__/page.test.tsx::renders the current terms text and version identifier
src/components/__tests__/TermsAcceptanceModal.test.tsx::renders terms text, a checkbox, a link to /terms, and a disabled submit until checked
criteria_coverage.notes: Terms page renders both TERMS_TEXT (first 40 chars) and CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION; modal asserts a concrete anchor with href='/terms', satisfying the linkable-from-prompt requirement.

criteria_coverage.criterion: AC8: On a terms version bump, previously-accepted teachers are required to act (forced re-acceptance) before their next upload.
covered_by: src/lib/__tests__/terms-acceptance.test.ts::returns false when the teacher's latest acceptance is for an older version
src/app/api/upload/__tests__/route.test.ts::returns 403 when the teacher's only acceptance record is for a version older than CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION
criteria_coverage.notes: The core mechanism (hasAcceptedCurrentTerms returns false for a stale version) is asserted at the unit level, which is the true version-axis coverage. The route-level 'older version' test re-establishes the block but mocks hasAcceptedCurrentTerms=false, so it is behaviorally identical to the no-record 403 case and adds documentation rather than independent version-axis coverage — see finding SR-04.

criteria_coverage.criterion: EDGE-race: Concurrent first-upload attempts from the same teacher must not create duplicate/conflicting acceptance records.
covered_by: src/lib/__tests__/terms-acceptance.test.ts::handles a duplicate-acceptance race without throwing an unhandled error
criteria_coverage.notes: Simulates a Postgres unique-violation (code 23505) and asserts recordAcceptance resolves idempotently with an acceptedAt string rather than rethrowing — exactly the contract Interface 4 idempotency invariant. (Tester reports this test currently fails against the implementation; that is an implementation defect, not a spec-encoding defect.)

test_findings.test: unauthenticated 401 branch (getCurrentTeacherId() === null) for terms-acceptance GET/POST and upload POST
test_findings.detail: The 401 unauthenticated branch is never exercised. createAuthModuleMock always resolves MOCK_TEACHER_ID, so no test drives teacherId=null. The 'unauthenticated -> 401 {error:'unauthenticated'}' contract behavior (Interface 5/6) is unverified. Recommend a per-route case overriding getCurrentTeacherId to resolve null, asserting 401 + {error:'unauthenticated'} and that recordAcceptance/hasAcceptedCurrentTerms are not called.

test_findings.test: TermsAcceptanceModal default success path (onAccepted omitted -> router.refresh() called)
test_findings.detail: The default success path (onAccepted omitted -> router.refresh()) is not positively asserted; the existing test only checks routerRefreshMock is NOT called when onAccepted is provided. The contract's fallback behavior for real Server-Component usage (Interface 8) is unverified. Recommend rendering the modal without onAccepted, stubbing fetch ok, clicking accept, and asserting routerRefreshMock was called once.

test_findings.test: renders terms text, a checkbox, a link to /terms, and a disabled submit until checked
test_findings.detail: The checkbox is selected via getByRole('checkbox') but the test never asserts the accessibility association the contract requires (associated <label> or aria-label, Interface 8). A checkbox without an accessible name would still pass. Recommend asserting an accessible name (e.g. getByLabelText, or checking for an associated label/aria-label).

test_findings.test: returns 403 when the teacher's only acceptance record is for a version older than CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION
test_findings.detail: This route test mocks hasAcceptedCurrentTerms=false, identical to the no-record test, so at the route boundary it does not independently exercise the version-mismatch axis (the version distinction lives inside the mocked hasAcceptedCurrentTerms). No coverage loss — the version axis is covered by the terms-acceptance unit test — but this route test is effectively a duplicate rather than independent version coverage. Acceptable as documentation; optionally consolidate.

test_findings.test: getAcceptanceStatus direct unit test (no row / matching version / older version)
test_findings.detail: getAcceptanceStatus has no direct unit test; it is exercised only transitively via the terms-acceptance GET route and settings/upload page tests (all of which mock it). Its accepted/not-accepted branching against CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION (Interface 4) is not unit-tested in isolation. Observable contract shapes are asserted by consumers, so impact is low. Recommend a direct unit test mirroring the hasAcceptedCurrentTerms cases.

one_line_summary: Approve: all 8 acceptance criteria plus the concurrency and server-authoritative edge cases are adequately covered by implementation-independent tests with strong, contract-consistent assertions; five advisory (non-blocking) findings recorded.
